name: PdfCraft
blurb: Read, organize, combine, split and secure PDFs in a fast, native app written in Rust from the ground up.
description:
PdfCraft is the all-in-one PDF tool for everyday document needs.

Merge documents, reorder and rotate pages, split PDFs, add passwords and redactions, fill forms, and annotate with pen or text without uploading sensitive documents to third-party web servers.

install.label: Cargo / Build from source
install.command: git clone https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft.git && cd pdfcraft && cargo run --release
install.note: Fast local PDF editor and organizer.
